choices.text: Give it to the council. Let them decide slowly.
Bury it. Some doors stay shut.

scenes.text:
Night. The crash field. All three fragments are singing now, and the sky over Vesper is doing something skies are not supposed to do.

The signal turns toward you like a flower toward the sun. It has been asking permission this whole time — the spectrometer's song, tomorrow's footage, the warm key — and now it asks [b]you[/b], {name}, directly:

[i]May I?[/i]
scenes.title: THE SKY OPENS
